semiconductor_relevance: High — Eurofins EAG provides specialized testing and consulting services for semiconductor materials and equipment, making it a key player in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: Eurofins EAG Materials Sciences offers professional testing and consulting services focused on semiconductor materials, chips, and high-purity materials. With advanced technical equipment and expertise, they support customers in troubleshooting, academic research, product innovation, and quality assurance.

regional_presence.China: Eurofins EAG operates a laboratory in Shanghai, employing 82 staff and providing localized services.
